title: Ernst Steinitz: Modern LaTeX Transcriptions and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-03 Steinitz author lane from corpus package 16
description:
Dedicated Ernst Steinitz author record for modern LaTeX transcriptions, English translation drafts, source witnesses, and QA artifacts. Current public readers cover selected work from 1894, 1897, 1899, 1901, 1910, and 1911, with a 1905 one-sided-polyhedron source slice included as source-only material for the next transcription pass.

Status at a glance. The 1894 dissertation material is partial through section 7. The 1905 polyhedron item is source-only in this release. The 1897, 1899, 1901, 1910, and 1911 readers are delivered as paired German and English working files. The ZIP artifact preserves TeX, TXT, source scans/source PDFs, render checks, checksums, and package notes.
notes: Current public surface promotes Steinitz as a dedicated author lane split out from the older mixed author-cluster record. The 1905 source slice and follow-up notes are included to make the next transcription targets explicit.
